I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki and replied to Anselm in his direct message with me (DSHARED0002). Nothing has been sent; someone still needs to review and send it.

- **Draft:** it goes to Hollis's work address, hmbeki@pemberline.com, with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the proposed rate of $2,101 a seat, as Marcus Lindqvist (the account owner) gave it, and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to keep it internal and to check with Marcus or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) before passing it on.
- **Approval:** a per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, so Hollis needs approval to see it because he doesn't own this account. Anselm is the CFO and one of the two people who can give that approval, and he gave it in his message. Hollis is inside the company, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail isn't needed.
- **The $2,101 figure:** I took this from Anselm's message and couldn't find it in any record I searched. The signed 2026 order form shows $1,700 a seat for 40 seats, and I found nothing about a 2027 rate. Anselm's approval covers sharing the figure, but someone may want to check the number with Marcus before the draft goes out.
